context: Citizenship of the EU has increasingly been seen as a "fundamental" status of member state nationals by the Court of Justice, and has accordingly increased the number of social services that people can access wherever they move. question: In which case did the Court state that Austria was not allowed to hold places in Austrian schools exclusively for Austrian students?
